title: Task target encoding
statement: For a task $	au$, a Boolean word $x$, and natural numbers $i$ and $t$, define the target condition as follows: when $	au$ is the edge task, $x$ encodes the pair of binary expansions of $i$ and $t$; for either other task, $x$ encodes the binary expansion of $t$ as a plain word.
